product_metadata.title: Zink Polaroid 64-Pocket Photo Album w/Sleek Quilted Cover for 3x4 Photo Paper (POP) - Pink
features: Memory Book Enables You to Arrange Up to 64 Mini Photos in a Sleek Cool Keepsake Album
Contains 16 Individual Pages with 2 Inserts Per Side [4 Total per Page]; Sheets Flip Like a Book for Easy Viewing
Textured Vinyl Cover & Sturdy Plastic Pockets Protect Pics From Dust & Wear; Funky Exterior Design
Interior Cover Features Helpful Pocket Flap for Storing Loose Photos
Versatile Mini Album Can Be Used as Craft Scrapbook, Memory Book, Wedding Gift, or Card Holder
description: Really big things come in small picture packages! Organize and display all your favorite mini photographs, small papers, and the like in the fabulous Polaroid 64-pocket photo album. Unlike traditional memory books, this cool multipurpose scrapbook boasts a sleek, shiny quilted exterior with interesting wave designs. The shell’s sturdy PVC construction ensures years of dependable wear, while the interior’s transparent plastic slides shield your keepsakes from dust, UV damage, and the effects of time. Inside, arrange and protect up to 64 mini photographs on 16 plastic book-style pages. Mix and match pictures, small artworks, postcards, stickers, tags, recipe cards, and so much more. Whether you’re crafting a menagerie of print memories or you’re simply looking for a place to commemorate the past, remember this. Don’t just place your pictures—tell a story. With our 64-pocket photo album, you’ll craft a personal tale to last the ages! What You Get 1 64 Pocket Photo Album 16 Built-In Photo Sheets Bonus Interior Pocket A mini album with maximum versatility! Specs & Details Book Material: PVC vinyl Total Pages: 16 Total Photo Capacity: 64 Pocket Size: approximately 3. 5" x 4. 25" Weighs in at 12 ounces
